question: Should limits[].kind gain a term for a cap on concurrent connections (for example concurrency-cap)? OVHcloud Managed Private Registry caps 15, 45 and 90 concurrent connections on plans S, M and L.
why: Not needed today: 95 of the limit rows that mention concurrent connections already use request-rate and 16 use per-ip-shaping, so the cap is proposed as a request-rate row. A rules session may still add a separate term if the operator wants concurrency told apart from rate; it would then re-file those rows.
